messages:
Elaine: Hi team — ACME POC call tomorrow. Buyer asked for SIG/CAIQ, our DPA + SCC stance, and exact DSAR/data deletion flow for the hosted POC. Also wants a two-month dedicated trial price. Can someone own the security/priv questions and the pricing slide?

Marco: I can own the CAIQ gaps. pls share the latest CAIQ template from the customer (they often use the 2023 CSA one). I’ll prefill known answers. Quick FYI: on hosted we mark some HSM/crypto controls as 'partial' because we rely on customer KMS integration for private deployments.

Jon: I’ll draft the trial pricing/options. For a 2-month POC we usually propose 2x GPUs with usage cap + burst; I can make a slide with a capped quote and a usage example. Who’s the legal approver for trial discounts?

Priya: On DPA/SCCs: Redwood can sign EU SCCs (we use the latest modular clauses) — we do require an appendix listing subprocessors. For POC: we offer a no-retention config (ops logs suppressed) + contract clause for deletion, but that needs legal signoff. DSARs: our standard process is 7 business days after verified request; deletion requests require tenant identifier + sample request id to target logs.

Elaine: @Marco can you call out which CAIQ rows are partial vs meet? ACME will probe for encryption/keys & DSAR handling.

Marco: yes — I’ll mark controls: CRYPTO-01 = meet (TLS), CRYPTO-02 = partial (no HSM on hosted), DATA-RET-03 = partial (default 30d request logs). For Dedicated/private we can meet HSM/KMS reqs. I’ll attach a short notes column in the spreadsheet.

Legal-bot: DPA template (redwood_dpa_v3.docx) uploaded to #sales-assets and sent to Elaine via email.

Jon: Pricing draft: I can offer a trial rate (2xV100/A100 equiv) + 100k token included per week; overage billed at standard POC rate. Slide will include a short sample cost calc and a refundable trial deposit option. Any objections?

Priya: Two privacy items to call out on the call: 1) retention defaults (we currently keep request/trace logs 30 days for hosted; we can enable 0-day retention for POC), 2) KV cache / model cache deletion — we must invalidate customer namespace to fully remove prompt artifacts. That’s an ops action.

ops-sre: For POC we can enable ephemeral logging. Set ENV: `LOG_RETENTION_DAYS=0` and flip `EPHEMERAL_MODE=true`. To invalidate cache run: ``POST /admin/tenants/{tenant_id}/invalidate-cache`` (auth required). I’ll prep runbook snippets for the call.

Marco: CAIQ note: we should be explicit about pen-test cadence + external audits. ACME asked about SOC2 type; we have SOC2 Type II and cert + ISO stuff — I’ll embed cert links in the CAIQ spreadsheet.

Priya: DSAR deletion nuance: for hosted requests we remove request metadata and user-identifiers; model fine-tuning artifacts and KV cache are per-tenant and subject to the invalidation flow (ops executes). We should surface timeline: deletion complete within 10 business days for hosted POC (ops + audit).

Elaine: Awesome. Action items: Marco -> prefill CAIQ + note cert links; Priya -> draft exact DSAR language + timeline; Jon -> pricing slide + cap example; ops-sre -> runbook & invalidate-cache snippet. I’ll consolidate into one packet for the buyer and send by noon. cc: @Legal-bot for DPA redlines. Thanks :thumbsup:

ops-sre: I’ll also add the curl example for invalidate: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/admin/tenants/ACME/invalidate-cache```

Elaine: Perfect — will include that snippet. If anyone finds a blocker call out now, otherwise I’ll ship the pack at 11:55am.
